# CrumbProof

> CrumbProof creates and verifies tamper-evident SHA-256 proof receipts on Cookie Chain.

Files and text are hashed locally in the browser. Only the fingerprint and public metadata are included in a signed Memo program transaction.

## Main actions

- Connect a Nightly Wallet configured for Cookie Chain.
- Create a fingerprint for a local file or text.
- Sign and confirm the proof transaction.
- Verify a receipt by Cookie Chain transaction signature.

## Network

- [Cookie Chain RPC](https://rpc.cookiescan.io): public JSON-RPC endpoint.
- [CookieScan](https://cookiescan.io): transaction explorer.
- [Cookie Chain documentation](https://docs.cookiechain.wtf): network and developer docs.
